title: Seating-Plan Completeness
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:task`), budget lines (`event:budget`), RSVPs (`event:rsvp`), vendor bookings (`event:vendor`), countdown milestones (`event:countdown`).
app: Wedding and event planning — task and budget spreadsheets, RSVP platforms (Zola, The Knot), vendor contracts, and seating tools — streamed to Splunk HEC via CSV exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:rsvp response=yes
| stats count as guests, sum(eval(if(isnotnull(table_number),1,0))) as seated
| eval unseated=guests-seated, complete_pct=round(100*seated/guests,1)
description: Checks how many confirmed guests have been assigned a table and how many still need seating.
value: A completeness score keeps the fiddly seating plan on track as RSVPs firm up.
implementation: Ingest seating assignments into `index=personal`; compare seated guests against confirmed guests.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how many of your confirmed guests have a seat yet, so the seating plan gets finished in time.
